review_summary: Independently audited Question 10 (9702_w20_41) across both answerable leaves (10(a) and 10(b)). Verification confirms rigorous pedagogical structure, physics correctness, and full alignment with Cambridge assessment standards: 10(a) covers the fundamental principles of CT scanning (use of X-rays, section scanning, multiple angle projections producing 2D slice images, axial repetition, and computer reconstruction into a 3D image) worth 5 marks; 10(b) accurately models CT voxel reconstruction with 4 viewing directions by subtracting background count (24) and dividing by 3 to determine K=6, L=7, M=2, N=9 worth 3 marks. Hints are progressively scaffolded without premature giveaways, walkthroughs are clear and logically sequenced, rubrics comprehensively match the official mark scheme, and curriculum mappings to 9702_t24_m02_o04 are exact.
